skill.name: loop-me
skill.description: Interview users about recurring activities and produce implementation-ready workflow specifications in the current workspace.
skill.summary: Turn recurring activities into clear workflow specifications through focused interviews.
skill.author: mattpocock

remediation.issue: Workflow specifications may be deleted without explicit user confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before deletion and preserve removed specifications through version control or an archive.

content.value_statement: Vague recurring tasks are difficult to delegate or automate. This skill asks focused questions and produces implementation-ready workflow specifications in your workspace.
actual_capabilities: Conducts a stateful interview with one focused question at a time.
Attaches a recommended answer to each interview question.
Identifies recurring activities that may benefit from delegation.
Creates, updates, and deletes Markdown workflow specifications.
Records workspace terminology and operating context in NOTES.md.
Continues until the specification has no unresolved implementation questions.
limitations: Depends on a /grilling session that this package does not define.
Produces workflow specifications, not working workflow implementations.
Expects workflows/*.md and NOTES.md conventions in the current workspace.
May delete existing specifications as decisions change.

use_cases.title: Specify Operations Intake
use_cases.description: Define triggers, processing steps, checkpoints, briefs, and completion criteria for a recurring intake process.

use_cases.title: Document Personal Routines
use_cases.description: Turn a repeated weekly activity into a clear specification that another person or agent can follow.

use_cases.title: Prepare Automation Requirements
use_cases.description: Resolve business rules and human decisions before implementing an automated workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Describe One Routine
prompt_templates.prompt: Interview me about my weekly status-report process and create a complete workflow specification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a known recurring task.

prompt_templates.title: Discover a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a recurring task in my notes that is worth delegating, then interview me and write its workflow specification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Identify a useful workflow from existing context.

prompt_templates.title: Define Checkpoints
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an event-triggered customer feedback workflow. Define inputs, checkpoints, briefs, failure handling, and completion criteria through focused questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Specify a workflow with human decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Related Workflows
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my related support loops. Propose coordinated workflows, minimize checkpoints, document shared terminology, and resolve every implementation question before finalizing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Design several connected workflows with shared rules.

output_examples.input: Create a workflow for reviewing new customer feedback.
output_examples.output: Created a specification covering the feedback event, classification steps, escalation rules, one approval checkpoint, and a decision-ready brief.

output_examples.input: Find a recurring task in my work notes that I could delegate.
output_examples.output: Identified weekly issue triage, clarified its trigger and ownership, documented terminology, and prepared an implementation-ready workflow specification.

output_examples.input: Reduce interruptions in our publishing approval process.
output_examples.output: Moved review to one late checkpoint and specified a concise brief containing the decision, rationale, completed work, and asset link.

best_practices: Answer each question with concrete examples, owners, inputs, and expected outcomes.
Keep workspace notes current so terminology remains consistent across specifications.
Review proposed deletions and use version control before changing existing specifications.
anti_patterns: Do not request implementation when you only need a workflow specification.
Do not add schedules, artificial intelligence, or checkpoints without evidence that the workflow needs them.
Do not accept unresolved terms or decisions in a final specification.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces Markdown specifications for recurring workflows in the current workspace.

faq.question: Does it implement the workflow?
faq.answer: No. It prepares a specification that an implementation agent can build.

faq.question: How does the interview work?
faq.answer: It asks one focused question at a time and includes a recommended answer.

faq.question: Can it discover workflows for me?
faq.answer: Yes. It can examine your described routines and notes to propose recurring activities worth specifying.

faq.question: Where are specifications stored?
faq.answer: The skill expects one Markdown file per workflow under the workflows directory.

faq.question: Can it change existing files?
faq.answer: Yes. It may create, edit, or delete specifications and update NOTES.md, so review changes with version control.
